title: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
summary: A lateral raise done seated, so you can't cheat the weight up with your legs.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for side delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.3 for traps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Sit on the end of a bench holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to shoulder height, leading with your elbows.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arms to shoulder height
Stop at shoulder height and keep your shoulders down.

mistakes.text: Leaning to swing the weight up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of dumbbell.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable.
